scheme_name: Internship Policy Of The Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be studying in one of the specified institutes: Institute of Hotel Management, Food Craft Institutes affiliated with the Government of India or Madhya Pradesh, Institutes of Travel and Tourism affiliated with the Government of India or Madhya Pradesh, Indian Institute of Forest Management, or any other institute permitted by the MP Tourism Board.

Applicant must be enrolled in one of the listed courses/programs such as MBA/BBA/BA (Tourism), B.Com (Tourism), B.Sc. in Hotel Management, Diploma/Certificate in Food Production/F&B Service/Front Office/Housekeeping, PG Diploma in Forest Management/Hotel Operations, or other tourism‑related courses like Photography, Digital Marketing, Advertising, Adventure Sports, Biodiversity, Tour Operators, etc.

The institute must send the request with required documents to the Deputy Director (Skill Development), Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board, 6th Floor, Lily Trade Wing, Jehangirabad, Bhopal (MP) – 462008, at least one month before the internship period.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend (₹5,000 to ₹1,500 depending on the course) and a certificate on successful completion of the internship.
